segments.name: Bottling Investments
segments.description: Consolidated bottling and distribution operations producing and selling finished beverages to retailers and distributors.
segments.evidence: These operations consist primarily of our consolidated bottling and distribution operations, which are included in our Bottling Investments operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Concentrate operations sell beverage concentrates and syrups to bottling partners; finished product operations sell finished beverages to retailers, distributors and wholesalers.
revenueModel.evidence: Our concentrate operations typically generate net operating revenues by selling beverage concentrates, sometimes referred to as "beverage bases," syrups, including fountain syrups, and certain finished beverages to authorized bottling operations.

changes.text: In 2025, the Global Ventures operating segment was sunset; Costa, innocent and doğadan businesses were moved to EMEA.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025, we sunset our Global Ventures operating segment to streamline and simplify our operating structure.
